name: Baghdad
type: federal capital; big city; largest city
text: Baghdad is the capital and the largest city of Iraq. It is located on the banks of the Tigris in central Iraq. With an estimated population of 8 million, it ranks among the most populous and largest cities in the Middle East and the Arab world and constitutes 22% of Iraq's population.

depictions.name: Baghdad
depictions.text: Baghdad (Arabic: بَغدَاد) is the capital of Iraq. It was founded in 762 by Al-Mansur, the second caliph of the Abbasid Caliphate, as the state's new capital, replacing Anbar. During the Abbasid period, the city was one of the foremost cultural, intellectual, and economic centers of the world, presiding over the Islamic Golden Age.
